_README: Copy this file to data/extras.json to add content that is not in the SRD.
data/extras.json is gitignored, so anything you put there stays on your machine
and is never published to GitHub Pages. The app loads it automatically if present.
Use this for the 2024 Player's Handbook material the SRD leaves out:
- the 12 backgrounds beyond Acolyte, Criminal, Sage and Soldier
- Origin feats beyond Alert, Magic Initiate, Savage Attacker and Skilled
Anything with an id that already exists REPLACES the core entry.
Anything with a new id is ADDED.
The entries below are fake placeholders showing the required shape.
Delete them and fill in the real values from your own copy of the book.

species.name: Example Species
species.tagline: One short line that sells the species.
species.plain: Two or three sentences in plain language for a new player.

traits.name: Example Trait
traits.text: The rules text for the trait.

backgrounds.name: Example Background
backgrounds.plain: Two sentences for a new player.

feats.name: Example Feat
feats.plain: What this feat does, in plain language.

benefits.name: Benefit Name
benefits.text: The rules text for the benefit.

spells.name: Example Spell
spells.higherLevel: What changes with a higher slot, or null.
